WHY OTTO 100

Versatility and durability in a small, powerful package

Application Versatility

OTTO 100 moves boxes, bins, carts and other lightweight payloads through a wide range of person-to-person workflows like workcell delivery, lineside delivery and work-in-progress transport.

Conveniently Integrated Lift

OTTO 100’s integrated lift works smoothly with carts that allow for simple, cost-effective modifications to carry a wide range of items.

Impressive Ruggedness

Resilient enough to withstand forklift collisions and carry on with its tasks, you can trust OTTO 100 to move your materials in challenging manufacturing environments.

ATTACHMENTS

Unlock countless workflows with attachments

Optimize your person-to-person workflows with a variety of attachments designed to simplify your operations.

Staging Cart

Move large bins, boxes and totes with an intuitively designed cart.

Conveyor

Move payloads to and from existing conveyors with the Jtec Powered Roller Attachment.

Don't see the attachment you're looking for?

Talk to a material handling expert about custom attachments, crafted just for your payloads.
